# Super Tannery (SPT IN)

Consumer Discretionary • India

Super Tannery Limited is a tanner and footwear manufacturer. The Company exports finished leather, footwear components, dress and casual shoes, as well as safety boots. Super Tannery processes leather from buffalo hides, cowhides and goat skins, their buffalo leather is good for making work shoes and safety boots while cowhides are for casual shoes and lining.
